'''Lanteeb''' was a neutral pastoral [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Malor-77 system]]. While aligned with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it did not have a representative in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. It was located equidistant between [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] and [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. It was located in [[Bri'ahl sector/Legends|Bri'ahl sector]].

==History==
Colonized by settlers from the highly-xenophobic world [[Rocantor]] c. [[421 BBY]], Lanteeb was a small backwater world that specialized in agriculture and mining. Joining the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], they avoided direct representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] due to their anti-alien laws. While the crop output was not enough to create a substantial offworld market, there was enough demand for [[damotite]] that a sufficient profit could be made. However as the years passed the market for damotite dwindled as [[trenomite]] became the preferred mineral. As jobs became scarce, the Lanteebans were forced to look offworld for jobs; however, their xenophobic natures more times than not caused them to lose any job they obtained.<ref name="CWG:S" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] a [[Tibanna gas hauler]] was passing through the system as it made repairs on its journey to [[Ryoone/Legends|Ryoone]] when it detected a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] fleet moving towards Lanteeb. A Republic agent on the gas hauler notified Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of this occurrence and the Senator immediately asked the assistance of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. While no records of the planet were to be found in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] discovered mention of the planet in the financial records of the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]]. Records indicated that two vials of damotite poisoning antidotes had been shipped to the world at great expense.<ref name="CWG:S" />
